thread:
Maria Chen: Heads up — noticed a sharp billing spike from synthetic checks in ap-southeast1 this morning. digging now, but numbers look like probe duplication across regions. :rotating_light:
Jon Patel: which probe types? streaming or embeddings?
Ashok Rao: Both streaming and embeddings. the synth lambda is configured in multiple regions for redundancy but looks like we accidentally turned on broadcast mode for the new sampler.
Lena Fischer: ugh. that would double-count tokens if each region sends the same request without a dedupe id. do we tag requests with a probe_id?
Samir Gupta: we do, but the header wasn't propagated through the sidecar on the new canary. probes-bot shows identical probe_ids coming from different regions.
probes-bot: automated: 1951112222 - duplicate_probe_detected - probe_id=cf2a9e, regions=[us-east1,ap-southeast1], tokens=128k
Maria Chen: sample prometheus snippet of what we alerted on earlier:
```
# alert rule we fired
alert: HighSyntheticBillingRate
expr: sum by (region) (increase(probe_tokens_total[1h])) > 50000
for: 10m
```
Jon Patel: that rule is region-scoped so it alerted per-region, but billing reports aggregate globally — duplicates inflate the global token count.
Lena Fischer: for SLO dashboards we also include a derived "inference_tokens_total" that doesn't exclude synthetic. we should strip synth tokens from SLO math.
Ashok Rao: quick mitigation: disable broadcast flag on the sampler and restart the canary sidecars in ap-southeast1. I can do that now.
Samir Gupta: also propose we add a "probe_origin_region" label and a boolean "probe_dedup" header so downstream collectors can dedupe. minimal change to ingest pipeline.
DevOps Bot: deployment triggered by Ashok Rao — rolling restart of sampler-canary in ap-southeast1 started (3 pods)
Maria Chen: follow-up: modify Prom rule to ignore probes with label probe_role="synthetic" until dedupe is in place. e.g.
```
expr: sum(increase(probe_tokens_total{probe_role!="synthetic"}[1h])) > 50000
```
Jon Patel: good call. also add a Grafana panel that shows "synthetic vs real tokens" by region so we can spot duplication faster.
Lena Fischer: for SLOs we should weight regional SLOs by production traffic rather than by token count, otherwise a noisy probe region throws off global error budgets.
Samir Gupta: action items:
 - Ashok: disable broadcast + restart sidecars in ap-southeast1 (in progress)
 - Maria: patch Prom alert to exclude synthetic tokens (5m)
 - Lena: update SLO dashboards to subtract synthetic metrics and add weight by prod traffic (today)
 - Jon: add dedupe header + tag to sampler and sidecar (this week)
 - Ops: add Grafana panel for synthetic vs real token split (this sprint)
Ashok Rao: disabled broadcast and rolled restarts. will watch billing over the next hour.
probes-bot: automated: 1951112250 - restart_succeeded - sampler-canary/ap-southeast1 - 3/3
Maria Chen: nice. early signal looks better, token spike already trending down. will keep monitoring and update incident if anything else pops. :thumbsup:
